post.description: Send ticket type ids and quantities only; the server computes every price. A zero-total order (free registration) is confirmed at once and its tickets issued. A paid order is `awaiting_payment` and holds its tickets until `expires_at`. `409 sold_out` when there aren't enough tickets left.
post.summary: Reserve tickets and create an order
Leave the DEMO payment step and release the reserved tickets

post.description: **DEMO: no real money moves.** `outcome` chooses what the simulated provider does. `succeed` confirms the order, issues the tickets and emails them. `fail` releases the tickets and emails a failure notice. Send a unique `Idempotency-Key` per attempt; repeating it returns the original result (200, `replayed: true`) instead of charging again. Reusing it for a different order is `409 idempotency_key_reused`.

parameters.description: A unique value per payment attempt, e.g. a UUID. Reuse it to retry safely.
